THURSDAY - FEBRUARY 23, 2017 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
AGENDA MATERIALS: Reports and materials related to items on this Agenda are available for public inspection at the City Clerk's Office, Cerritos City Hall, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1248. Materials submitted to the City Council/Successor Agency after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's Office at the above address during normal business hours as noted.
PUBLIC COMMENTS: For all Agenda Items, except for Consent Calendar Items, public comments will be allowed at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered. The general public comments portion of the meeting, under Agenda Item 6, will not exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five minutes, unless determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of appropriate responses, persons are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record.
PUBLIC HEARINGS: Public hearings will be conducted in the order indicated on the agenda, unless otherwise directed. Please complete and submit a blue Speakers Card if you wish to present testimony. Conduct of public hearings will occur in substantially the following sequence: the item to be heard is announced, a report of written correspondence and staff report are received, and the City Council asks questions of staff. The public hearing is opened and verbal testimony will occur in the following order: the applicant, if applicable, those in favor, opposed, or interested parties, and rebuttal by applicant. Speakers are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record. After verbal testimony, the public hearing is closed and the matter is deliberated with a determination being made or a continuation of the matter.

MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT HELD ON FEBRUARY 23,
2017, IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS AT CERRITOS CITY HALL, 18125 BLOOMFIELD
AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Pastor Dustin Parker, Concordia Lutheran Church.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by the Warriors Rookie II Basketball Team.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in
  attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Carol Chen
  Council/Agency Member Jim Edwards
  Council/Agency Member Mark E. Pulido
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Naresh Solanki
  Mayor/Chair George Ray

5.  Presentations/Appointments

5A.  Presentations

  Proclamations presented to:

  Valley Christian High School Crusaders Football Team (Olympic League Champions)

  Lexus of Cerritos (Business Spotlight).

5B.  Consideration of appointments to Commissions, Committees, and Boards
  (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Solanki, to approve the
  following appointments (COUNCIL):

  Park and Recreation Commission  Brad Beach
  Planning Commission  Larry Sagert

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  February 23, 2017
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 2 of 5

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  Angel Soto spoke in opposition to the Attorney General's opinion regarding
  Proposition H.

  Martin Grossman spoke regarding various budget cuts recommended by the City
  Council over the past year.

  Gail Grossman spoke regarding the Women's Club of Artesia-Cerritos and mentioned
  their upcoming sponsorship of a candidate's forum.

  Chris Foster spoke regarding a blanket email alleging a former Councilmember was
  ineligible to run for office in the 2017 election.

  Sally Havice spoke regarding Su Casa services for victims of domestic violence and
  inquired regarding the status of the auto museum.

7.  Consent Calendar
  Items under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by
  one motion. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless a
  Council/Agency Member or citizen so requests, in which event the item will be
  removed from the Consent Calendar and considered separately.

7A.  Approval of the City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of
  February 9, 2017 (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the City
  Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of February 9, 2017
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY). The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7B.  Approval of the Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated February 23,
  2017 (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the
  Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated February 23, 2017 in the
  amount of $1,554,706.94 (COUNCIL). The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7C.  Approval of the Register of Demands for the Successor Agency to the Cerritos
  Redevelopment Agency dated February 23, 2017 (SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the
  Register of Demands for the Successor Agency to the Cerritos Redevelopment
  Agency dated February 23, 2017 in the amount of $674,710.00 (SUCCESSOR
  AGENCY).
 City of Cerritos  February 23, 2017
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 3 of 5

7.  Consent Calendar (continued)

7C.  (continued)

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7D.  Award of Bid No. 1286-17, Cerritos Center for the Performing Arts mailing list
  data processing services (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to approve Bid No.
  1286-17 to Marketing Software Company for the Cerritos Center for the Performing
  Arts Mailing List Data Processing Services for a term of 18 months, with an
  extension by mutual agreement of both parties for up to three additional 12-months
  terms (COUNCIL). The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

8.  Public Hearings

8A.  Review and consideration to waive reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CITY OF CERRITOS AMENDING THE COMPREHENSIVE FEE SCHEDULE FOR
  DEVELOPMENT, PLANNING, AND PUBLIC WORKS RELATED FEES (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Kristin Aguila, Advance Planning Manager. A
  PowerPoint Presentation was displayed. Additional comments were made by the
  City’s consultant, Tony Thrasher, representing the Willdan Group.

  The Mayor opened the public hearing and public comments.

  Marlene Rofe inquired as to the potential impacts of the new fees on residents.

  Noting there were no further individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor closed
  public comments and the public hearing.

  MOTION: It was moved by Chen, and seconded by Solanki, to waive full reading
  of and adopt Resolution No. 2017-4, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY OF
  CERRITOS AMENDING THE COMPREHENSIVE FEE SCHEDULE FOR
  DEVELOPMENT, PLANNING, AND PUBLIC WORKS RELATED FEES, as
  amended to include a review of the fee schedule every five (5) years (COUNCIL).
  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  February 23, 2017
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 4 of 5

9.  New and Old Business

9A.  Review and consideration of an informational report to the Cerritos City Council
  regarding a clarification of the presentation of direct and overlapping bond debt
  within the financial documents of the City of Cerritos and the ABC Unified School
  District pertaining to bonds issued by the ABC Unified School District (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Ryan Carey, Budget Manager.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who elected to
  speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Solanki, to receive and file the
  report (COUNCIL). The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9B.  Review and consideration of award of a contract for Bid No. 1287-17, Cerritos
  Center for the Performing Arts Sierra Room roof replacement, Project No. 12706
  (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Kanna Vancheswaran, City Engineer.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who elected to
  speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to reject the sole bid
  and authorize staff to re-bid the project at a future date (COUNCIL). The motion
  carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9C.  Review and consideration of a City website redesign (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Laurie Kajiwara, Public Information Manager.

  The Mayor opened public comments.

  Anantha Ramachandran expressed interest in the update of the City's website as an
  opportunity to provide services to residents.

  Noting there were no further individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor closed
  public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Ray, and seconded by Pulido, to defer consideration of
  this item to the budget study session scheduled for April 27, 2017 (COUNCIL). The
  motion carried (4 - 1) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray
  NOES:  Chen
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  February 23, 2017
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 5 of 5

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9D.  Review and consideration of a mutual release/contract termination agreement of
  the Complete Landscape Care, Inc. contract for maintenance of Cerritos arterial,
  center median and additional public landscaped areas (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Todd Kuh, Parks Superintendent.

  Sally Havice confirmed that the contractor requested to be released from their
  obligations.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no further individuals who
  elected to speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Chen, and seconded by Edwards, to:

  1. Authorize the City Manager to execute the Mutual Release and Termination
  Agreement for Complete Landscape Care, Inc.; and
  2. Authorize the City Manager to execute a change order to the existing Valley
  Crest Landscape Maintenance, Inc. (Bright View, LLC) contract to provide for
  the maintenance of the center medians and arterial planting areas
  (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Chen, Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

10.  Legislative Items

10A.  Report on pending legislation

  None.

10B.  Review and consideration to support or oppose specific legislation in the State or
  Federal Legislature or in the State or Federal Executive Office for signature.

  None.

11.  City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings

  Reports were provided by Councilmembers Pulido, Chen, and Edwards, Mayor
  Pro Tem Solanki, and Mayor Ray.

12.  Closed Session

13.  Adjournment

  The meeting was adjourned at 9:02 p.m. in memory of Whittier Police Officer
  Keith William Boyer.
  /s/Vida Barone______________________
  Vida Barone, City Clerk/Agency Secretary
